investigation_notes.Description: An anomalous bulk download of 3,450 SharePoint files was observed for a user whose 24-hour baseline is 12 downloads, originating from Klaipeda, Lithuania with a Python aiohttp user agent. The files listed include highly sensitive R&D, patent, encryption, and M&A materials and the destination IP resolves to a Microsoft data center. This activity is classified as high priority due to the unusually large, scripted access pattern targeting highly sensitive content and the transfer to an external datacenter, which raises significant risk of data exfiltration and requires escalation.
